scopeFallback: The app did not receive all required permissions. Try connecting again and approve every requested right.
operatorConfigMessage: This connection isn't fully set up yet for your organization. This isn't something you can fix yourself — contact whoever administers Automazing for your team so they can finish the configuration.

oauth.not_authenticated: The sign-in session was missing when OAuth finished. Open the app again, stay signed in, and restart Connect from the same page.
oauth.access_denied: The provider denied access. Try connecting again and approve the requested permissions.
oauth.invalid_state: OAuth state does not match — the link may have expired, another tab interfered, or cookies blocked the response. Start Connect again from a single tab.
oauth.user_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled at the provider. Try again when you are ready to approve access.
oauth.interaction_required: The provider requires an extra sign-in step. Try connecting again and complete every dialog.
oauth.token_exchange_failed: Could not exchange the authorization code for a token. Check that OAuth keys and callback URLs are configured correctly.
oauth.missing_code: The provider sent no authorization code. Try again — if it persists, check the configuration.
oauth.scope_not_granted: The app did not receive all required permissions. Try connecting again and select every requested right.
oauth.account_already_connected: This account is already connected to another profile.
oauth.gmail_not_configured: Gmail is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and the Gmail callback URL in Google Cloud.
oauth.outlook_not_configured: Outlook is missing Microsoft OAuth configuration. Check MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID, MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET, and the callback URL in Azure/Entra.
oauth.google_drive_not_configured: Google Drive is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and the Drive callback in Google Cloud.
oauth.canva_not_configured: Canva is missing Canva Connect configuration. Check CANVA_CLIENT_ID, CANVA_CLIENT_SECRET, and the callback URL in the Canva Developer Portal.
oauth.google_calendar_not_configured: Google Calendar is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and the Calendar callback in Google Cloud.
oauth.outlook_calendar_not_configured: Outlook Calendar is missing Microsoft OAuth configuration. Check MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID, MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET, and the callback URL in Azure/Entra.
oauth.google_business_not_configured: Google Business official is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and that the Google Business Profile API is enabled.
oauth.google_business_accounts_api_failed: Google Business could not read accounts from Google. Check that the Google Business Profile API is enabled and the account can access the business profile.
oauth.google_business_locations_api_failed: Google Business could not read locations from Google. Check that the account can access at least one verified location and that the Business Information API is enabled.
oauth.google_business_no_account_access: The Google account has no access to a Google Business account. Connect with an account that owns or administers the business profile.
oauth.google_business_no_location_access: The Google account has no access to any Google Business location. Check permissions and that the location exists in Business Profile Manager.
oauth.google_reviews_not_configured: Google Reviews is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and that the Google Business Profile API is enabled.
oauth.google_reviews_no_account_access: Google OAuth succeeded, but no Business Profile account is available for this Google user. Connect with an account that owns or administers the business profile.
oauth.google_reviews_no_location_access: A Business account was found, but no locations are available. Check that the location is claimed and shared with this Google user.
oauth.google_reviews_accounts_api_failed: Google Business Accounts API failed. Check that Business Profile APIs are enabled in Google Cloud and the OAuth app is approved.
oauth.google_reviews_locations_api_failed: Google Business Locations API failed. Check API enablement and permissions for Business Profile.
oauth.tripadvisor_not_configured: Tripadvisor official is missing an API key or location id. Add TRIPADVISOR_API_KEY and TRIPADVISOR_LOCATION_ID in the environment or under Preferences → API keys.
oauth.shopify_not_configured: Shopify is missing app configuration. Check SHOPIFY_API_KEY, SHOPIFY_API_SECRET, and the callback URL in the Shopify app.
oauth.shopify_public_url_missing: Shopify requires a public HTTPS host (e.g. a tunnel). Set SHOPIFY_APP_URL in the environment before connecting.
oauth.shopify_public_url_must_be_https: SHOPIFY_APP_URL must start with https://. Use the tunnel’s HTTPS URL.
oauth.shopify_invalid_shop: The shop address is not a valid Shopify store. Use the format mystore.myshopify.com (3–60 characters, letters/numbers/hyphens).
oauth.shopify_missing_shop: Shopify requires a shop domain. Enter it as mystore.myshopify.com and try again.
oauth.missing_shopify_permission: Shopify denied a permission that is not approved for the app. Remove customer_* scopes and other unapproved rights in the Shopify Partner Dashboard (App setup → Access scopes) and in SHOPIFY_EXTRA_SCOPES. Connect with read_products first; add read_orders/read_customers only after Shopify has approved them.
oauth.shopify_shop_mismatch: Shopify responded with a different shop domain than you started with. Start the connection again and check the domain.
oauth.notion_not_configured: Notion is missing OAuth configuration. Check NOTION_CLIENT_ID, NOTION_CLIENT_SECRET, and the callback URL in the Notion integration.
oauth.notion_public_url_must_be_https: Notion requires a public HTTPS host. Set NOTION_APP_URL in the environment to your tunnel URL.
oauth.backend_unavailable: The backend server is unreachable. Start the API server (port 3001) before connecting the integration.
oauth.youtube_not_configured: YouTube is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and the YouTube scope/callback.
oauth.tiktok_not_configured: TikTok is missing OAuth configuration. Check TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY, TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET, and the redirect URL in the TikTok portal.
oauth.x_not_configured: X is missing OAuth configuration. Check X_CLIENT_ID, X_CLIENT_SECRET, and the callback URL in the X Developer Portal.
oauth.invalid_pkce_state: OAuth PKCE state is missing or invalid. Start the connection again from Connections in a single tab.
oauth.meta_business_not_configured: Meta Business official is missing an app ID or app secret. Add META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET in API settings and check the callback URL in the Meta app.
oauth.google_ads_not_configured: Google Ads is missing Google OAuth configuration. Check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and Google Ads API settings.
oauth.zernio_not_configured: Zernio is not configured. Add ZERNIO_API_KEY and connect a Zernio profile, or use Official API if the platform supports it.
oauth.zernio_profile_failed: The Zernio profile could not be found or created for the active business profile. Check the business profile link and Zernio settings.
oauth.zernio_connect_failed: Zernio rejected the connect request. Check the API key, that the platform is supported in Zernio, and that the profile has the right permissions.
oauth.zernio_no_auth_url: Zernio returned no sign-in link. Try again or use Official API if available.
oauth.zernio_gmb_not_supported: Zernio does not support Google Business in this workspace. Use Official API for Google Business from Connections.
oauth.zernio_gmb_selection_failed: Google Business requires location selection. Open Connections and finish Google Business there, or use Official API.
oauth.google_business_use_official: Use Official API for Google Business from Connections, or link the location via Zernio if supported.
oauth.zernio_init_failed: Zernio could not start the connection. Try Official API if available, or check ZERNIO_API_KEY and ZERNIO_PROFILE_ID.
oauth.zernio_fetch_failed: The server could not reach Zernio’s connect endpoint. This can be a Zernio outage, a wrong ZERNIO_API_BASE, or an unsupported platform in your Zernio account. Try Official API for Meta Business if Zernio keeps failing.
oauth.zernio_platform_not_supported: Zernio does not support this platform in your workspace. Use the official API connection instead.
oauth.instagram_not_configured: Instagram official is missing OAuth configuration. Check INSTAGRAM_CLIENT_ID, INSTAGRAM_CLIENT_SECRET, and the callback URL.
oauth.shopify_hmac_invalid: Shopify could not verify the callback signature. Check SHOPIFY_API_SECRET and that the callback URL matches the app.
oauth.zernio_no_account: Zernio returned no connected account after sign-in. Check the Zernio profile and try connecting again.
oauth.zernio_fetch_accounts_failed: Could not fetch accounts from Zernio after sign-in. Try again or use Official API.
oauth.meta_profile_failed: Meta OAuth partly succeeded but could not read the business profile. Check the Meta app permissions and Business Manager access.
oauth.unknown_platform: Unknown OAuth platform. Pick the integration again from Connections.
oauth.client_registration_failed: MCP OAuth registration failed at the provider. Check MCP client credentials and scopes.
oauth.invalid_scope: The OAuth app requested scopes that are not approved or allowed. Check the provider’s developer portal and environment variables for extra scopes.
